zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as a_name, sum(total) as b, sum(inyear) as c, sum(low_risk) as f, sum(inrepeat) as e, sum(b030_1) as b030_1, sum(b030_over1) as b030_over1, sum(b030_2) as b030_2, sum(b030_over2) as b030_over2, sum(b030_3) as b030_3, sum(b030_over3) as b030_over3, sum(b031_1) as b031_1, sum(b031_over1) as b031_over1, sum(b031_2) as b031_2, sum(b031_over2) as b031_over2, sum(b031_3) as b031_3, sum(b031_over3) as b031_over3, sum(b032_1) as b032_1, sum(b032_over1) as b032_over1, sum(b032_2) as b032_2, sum(b032_over2) as b032_over2, sum(b032_3) as b032_3, sum(b032_over3) as b032_over3, sum(b033_1) as b033_1, sum(b033_over1) as b033_over1, sum(b033_2) as b033_2, sum(b033_over2) as b033_over2, sum(b033_3) as b033_3, sum(b033_over3) as b033_over3, sum(v_b030) as v_b030, sum(v_b031) as v_b031, sum(v_b032) as v_b032, sum(v_b033) as v_b033, sum(v_b030 + v_b031 + v_b032 + v_b033) as v_total FROM chospital as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) GROUP BY h.zone_code, h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

province.label: จังหวัด
